name: LEJU ROBOT
summary:
Leju Robotics develops humanoid platforms for research, commercial services and industrial applications. Its Kuavo family includes full-size bipedal and wheeled-arm configurations, with current products presented as open platforms for embodied-intelligence development. The company supplies both robot hardware and application-oriented solutions.

Public use cases include exhibition guidance, retail assistance, banking services and tasks in automotive manufacturing, electronics and logistics. It also offers research and training-ground solutions supporting robot data collection and model development. This connects its humanoid product line with the infrastructure needed to develop, test and adapt robot capabilities across different operating environments.
